title: Disney Channel Throwback
theme: Disney Channel: DCOMs, sitcoms and High School Musical
intro: [excited] Grab your flip phone and your frosted tips, because tonight is a DISNEY CHANNEL THROWBACK! Original Movies, sitcoms, and one very sparkly high school musical... [laughs] Get your head in the game, people!

art.prompt: A glowing 2000s teen bedroom at night: a chunky retro CRT television casting colorful light, a flip phone, a sparkly microphone, a basketball, scattered DVDs, star-shaped fairy lights and a lava lamp, nostalgic Y2K colors of teal, purple and lime, 16:9, original artwork, no text, no logos, no characters, no people

categories.title: We're All in This Together
categories.intro: [excited] Wildcats, get your heads in the game! This whole category is High School Musical. Jazz squares are optional but encouraged.

art.prompt: A shiny high school gymnasium with a polished basketball court, red and white pennants, a spotlight on center court, a basketball resting beside a stage microphone, confetti in the air, 16:9, original artwork, no text, no logos, no characters, no people

clues.clue: In High School Musical, Troy Bolton is the star player on the East High Wildcats team for this sport.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is basketball! [chuckles] Troy can sink a free throw AND hit a high note. Overachiever.

clues.clue: Troy and Gabriella first meet when they are pulled up to sing karaoke at a ski lodge party on this holiday.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is New Year's Eve! They sang Start of Something New, and wow, they were not kidding.

clues.clue: Sharpay Evans's twin brother, who co-stars with her in every show and owns a LOT of hats.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Ryan Evans! [laughs] Every hat in that wardrobe deserves its own curtain call.

clues.clue: In High School Musical 2, the Wildcats spend their summer working at this fancy country club owned by Sharpay's family.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Lava Springs! [sarcastic] Nothing says relaxing summer job like Sharpay as your boss.

clues.clue: East High is a real school, and much of the original High School Musical was filmed there, in this state capital.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Salt Lake City, Utah! [whispers] The movie pretends it's Albuquerque... but the hallways are pure Utah.

categories.title: DCOM Marathon
categories.intro: [mischievously] Pop the popcorn and fight your siblings for the remote. It's a Disney Channel Original Movie marathon!

art.prompt: A cozy living room movie marathon fort made of blankets and pillows, bowls of popcorn, a stack of glowing DVD cases, a jack-o-lantern, a snowboard leaning on the couch and a retro robot vacuum, warm TV glow, 16:9, original artwork, no text, no logos, no characters, no people

clues.clue: In Halloweentown, Marnie discovers that she and her grandma Aggie are both these.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is witches! [excited] Grandma Aggie brought the magic and the BEST candy.

clues.clue: Zenon Kar, the Girl of the 21st Century, lives in the year 2049 aboard one of these.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is a space station! [chuckles] Zoom zoom zoom, make my heart go boom boom.

clues.clue: In 1999's Smart House, the computer program that runs the house and goes WAY too far is named this.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is PAT, the Personal Applied Technology! [sighs] She just wanted to be the perfect mom. A little too perfect.

clues.clue: In Johnny Tsunami, a Hawaiian surfer moves to Vermont, where the skiers are feuding with kids who do this.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is snowboarding! [laughs] It's surfing, but colder and with more falling down.

clues.clue: Released in 1997 and starring a friendly mummy, this is considered the very first Disney Channel Original Movie.
clues.reveal: [gasps] The correct answer is Under Wraps! The DCOM dynasty started with a mummy. It's a WRAP, folks.

categories.title: Throwback Zoom
categories.intro: [whispers] Lean in close... CLOSER. We start super zoomed in on a scene from a Disney Channel show, then slowly pull back. Buzz in when you know it!

art.prompt: A wall of glowing vintage television screens each showing a different colorful abstract pattern, a remote control and a magnifying glass in the foreground, neon teal and purple glow, 16:9, original artwork, no text, no logos, no characters, no people

clues.clue: Zoom out on this pop-star secret. Which Disney Channel show is it?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Hannah Montana! [laughs] One blonde wig, and NOBODY recognizes you. Best of both worlds.

media.prompt: A long sparkly blonde pop-star wig on a mannequin head in front of a hidden walk-in closet full of glittering stage outfits, a bedazzled microphone and a beach house window overlooking the Malibu ocean, no people, no text, no logos, no copyrighted characters

clues.clue: Zoom out on this fancy lobby. Which Disney Channel show is it?
clues.answer: The Suite Life of Zack & Cody

clues.reveal: The correct answer is The Suite Life of Zack and Cody! [chuckles] Somewhere a hotel manager is yelling about running in the lobby.

media.prompt: A grand luxury hotel lobby in Boston with a polished marble floor, a brass luggage cart piled with suitcases, a front desk bell, a fragile tall vase on a pedestal and a candy counter, no people, no text, no logos, no copyrighted characters

clues.clue: Zoom out on this vision. Which Disney Channel show is it?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is That's So Raven! [gasps] Ya know... she saw that one coming.

media.prompt: A colorful San Francisco row house kitchen where a swirling purple psychic vision glows in the air, a fashion sketchbook on the table and a cable car visible outside the window, no people, no text, no logos, no copyrighted characters

clues.clue: Zoom out on this summer project. Which Disney Channel show is it?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Phineas and Ferb! [excited] 104 days of summer vacation, and they built a roller coaster on day one.

media.prompt: A suburban backyard with a giant wooden roller coaster rising from behind a picket fence, a big shady tree, blueprints on a picnic table and a teal fedora hanging on a garden gnome, no people, no text, no logos, no copyrighted characters

clues.clue: Zoom out on this tourist trap. Which Disney Channel show is it?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Gravity Falls! [mischievously] Trust no one. Especially the guy selling mystery souvenirs.

media.prompt: A crooked old wooden tourist-trap shack deep in an Oregon pine forest, with a lopsided rooftop sign shape, a totem pole, a golf cart, glowing journal with a six-fingered hand print and fog between the trees, no people, no text, no logos, no copyrighted characters

categories.title: Channel Surfing the Parks
categories.intro: [excited] Disney Channel didn't just stay on TV. It went to the PARKS! Let's channel surf our way around the resorts.

art.prompt: A sunny theme park street at golden hour with a vintage TV-studio soundstage facade, spotlights, a pair of round black mouse-ear headbands on a souvenir stand and a spy gadget phone on a bench, 16:9, original artwork, no text, no logos, no characters, no people

clues.clue: The original Mouseketeers made this headgear famous, and guests still buy it at every Disney park.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is mouse ears! [laughs] Wearing them adds exactly zero IQ points and one thousand fun points.

clues.clue: Disney's Hollywood Studios' Tower of Terror is themed to this classic TV series hosted by Rod Serling.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is The Twilight Zone! [whispers] Your next stop... is a thirteen-story drop.

clues.clue: In 2009, EPCOT launched an interactive spy game across World Showcase starring this teen crime-fighter from Disney Channel.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Kim Possible! Guests carried special phones called Kimmunicators. [chuckles] Call me, beep me!

clues.clue: In 2012, the World Showcase spy game switched to missions for this secret agent, the pet of two stepbrothers.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Perry the Platypus, also known as Agent P! [laughs] He fought Dr. Doofenshmirtz in seven countries.

clues.clue: Future stars like Britney Spears, Justin Timberlake and Ryan Gosling taped the 1989 All New Mickey Mouse Club at this Walt Disney World park.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Disney-MGM Studios, now Hollywood Studios! [gasps] Imagine buying a ticket and watching future pop royalty rehearse.

categories.title: Catchphrase Channel
categories.intro: [mischievously] Our voice actor is about to do some VERY dramatic readings of famous Disney Channel catchphrases. You tell me who says it!

art.prompt: A retro recording studio vocal booth with a vintage microphone, colorful speech-bubble-shaped neon lights without letters, headphones and a stack of 2000s TV scripts, 16:9, original artwork, no text, no logos, no characters, no people

clues.clue: Which Disney Channel character says this?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Raven Baxter! [laughs] Two little words, and a whole generation started snapping.

clues.clue: Which Disney Channel villain says this, over and over?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Dr. Doofenshmirtz! [sighs] Defeated by a platypus. Every. Single. Week.

clues.clue: Which Disney Channel character says this?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Miley Stewart, a.k.a. Hannah Montana! [chuckles] Sweet niblets is still the best way to say wow.

clues.clue: Which Disney Channel hotel manager says this?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Mr. Moseby! [laughs] That lobby was a sacred space, and the twins treated it like a racetrack.

clues.clue: Which Disney Channel sidekick shouts this when he's excited?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Ron Stoppable! [excited] BOOYAH! Kim Possible's best buddy, and owner of a naked mole rat.
